subject: psychiatry
title: Cannabis, stimulants, nicotine and other substances

steps.tx: **Cannabis** dependence shows craving, tolerance and withdrawal (irritability, insomnia, vivid dreams, appetite loss) peaking days after cessation in heavy users, while intoxication impairs driving and learning. High potency daily adolescent use multiplies psychosis risk and can precipitate schizophrenia in vulnerable youth; cannabis induced psychosis with persisting symptoms beyond intoxication needs psychosis pathway care. Cannabinoid hyperemesis syndrome (compulsive hot bathing relief) resolves with cessation.
steps.say: Heavy cannabis withdraws irritable and sleepless. Strong daily teen use feeds psychosis. Endless vomiting eased by hot showers is hyperemesis.

steps.tx: **Stimulants** (cocaine, amphetamines, methamphetamine) intoxicate with euphoria, mydriasis, tachycardia, hypertension, hyperthermia and bruxism, toxic with chest pain (coronary spasm), arrhythmia, seizures, rhabdomyolysis and excited delirium; benzodiazepines are first line for stimulant toxicity agitation and cardiovascular surge, avoiding pure beta blockade in cocaine chest pain dogma pathways per cardiology guidance. Withdrawal crashes with hypersomnia, hyperphagia and dysphoria, suicide vigilance needed. No approved substitution drug exists; contingency management has best evidence.
steps.say: Stimulant storm gets benzodiazepines. Crash afterwards risks suicide. No methadone equivalent exists; reward based therapy works best.

steps.tx: **Nicotine dependence** drives most preventable death via smoking diseases; brief advice plus pharmacotherapy (combination NRT patch plus short acting form, varenicline highest single agent quit rates via alpha4beta2 partial agonism, bupropion alternative) doubles or triples quit success. Varenicline neuropsychiatric fears were not confirmed in large safety trials. E cigarettes help some adult smokers quit when complete switching occurs, while never smokers (especially youth) should not start any nicotine.
steps.say: Patch plus gum beats single NRT. Varenicline quits most and is safer than feared. Help smokers switch fully or quit, never recruit youth.

steps.tx: **Key point.** Other substances fill patterns: MDMA (serotonin toxicity, hyponatraemia from water loading), hallucinogens (perceptual distortion, hallucinogen persisting perception), inhalants (sudden sniffing death arrhythmia, cognitive damage), GHB (steep dose response, severe withdrawal needing high dose benzodiazepines), synthetic cannabinoids (severe agitation and psychosis beyond natural cannabis), ketamine (ulcerative cystitis, dependence) and gabapentinoid misuse with opioids. Polysubstance use is the rule, so histories must inventory everything including prescribed and online drugs.
steps.say: Every drug history inventories all substances. Synthetics hit harder than natural versions; ketamine scars bladders.

rows: Crash dysphoria, no specific antidote drug
